_doc: Drone scans per site, keyed by OSM id (e.g. "way/780152646"). See docs/drone-scans.md. 'overlay' places our footprint (metres, x east, y up, z south, origin = footprint centroid at ground) into the splat's frame; get it from the viewer's Align tool. 'findings' comes from the viewer's Findings tab.
